subject: Grade 3 field trip to Riverton Science Center, Fri Nov 6
body: Dear Grade 3 families, we visit the Riverton Science Center on Friday Nov 6. Please sign the permission slip in the Wednesday folder and send it back with the $12 trip fee (cash or the school payments portal) by Tuesday Nov 3. Children need a packed lunch in a disposable bag and closed-toe shoes. We leave at 8:45 sharp.

subject: Fall bake sale: volunteers and baked goods needed
body: Our fall bake sale is Thursday Nov 5 at pickup. We still need 6 volunteers for the 2:45 to 3:45 shift and donations of nut-free baked goods, individually wrapped and labeled. Sign up on the PTA volunteer sheet by Monday Nov 2. Thank you!

subject: Picture retake day is Wednesday Nov 4
body: Picture retakes are Wednesday Nov 4 during homeroom. Students who were absent on the first picture day or who want a retake should bring their original photo packet. Students in the yearbook club photo should wear their navy club shirt.

subject: Grade 6 science fair registration closes Nov 9
body: Hello families, science fair registration closes Monday Nov 9. Each student submits a one-paragraph proposal and a signed parent agreement form (attached to the class page). Projects that use live animals or food need extra approval. Theo has not registered yet.

subject: Low lunch balance for Theo
body: This is a reminder that the lunch account for Theo has a balance of $3.20. A balance below $5.00 may mean a substitute meal. Please add funds through the school payments portal. Suggested top-up: $40.

subject: Library books and PE on Tuesdays
body: A quick reminder: library day is Tuesday, so please send back the library books by then (Maya has two out). PE is also on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so sneakers on those days please.

subject: Maplewood Weekly: November news
body: In this issue: a welcome to our new art teacher, photos from the autumn walk, the reading challenge leaderboard, and the November calendar. Reminder: there is no school on Wednesday Nov 11 for Veterans Day. Have a great weekend!

subject: Bring instruments home this weekend and back Monday
body: Beginning band students: please take your instrument home this weekend to practice the two scales on the handout, and bring it back on Monday Nov 2. The winter concert is Dec 10 at 6:30 pm; concert dress is a white top and black pants.

subject: Flu vaccine clinic: consent form due Nov 4
body: A free flu vaccine clinic for students runs at both schools on Monday Nov 9. Students can only take part with a signed consent form, returned to the school office by Wednesday Nov 4. If you do not want your child vaccinated at school, no action is needed.

subject: Pajama day this Friday
body: Friday Nov 6 is pajama and book day at Maplewood. Students may wear school-appropriate pajamas and bring a favourite book. Grade 3 is on the field trip that day, so Grade 3 should wear regular clothes and closed-toe shoes instead.

subject: Math quiz Thursday and a signature
body: There is a fractions quiz on Thursday Nov 5. Please sign the returned unit 2 test (it went home on Friday) so Theo can bring it back by Wednesday. A calculator is not allowed on Thursday.

subject: Lost and found clears out Friday
body: All items left in the lost and found will be donated after school on Friday Nov 6. We currently have 14 water bottles and several hoodies, including a grey Cedar Ridge hoodie with the initials T.A. on the tag.

subject: Form attached
body: Please complete the attached form and return it by the date shown. Thank you.

subject: Cross country end of season party
body: Our end of season party is Saturday Nov 7 at Alder Park from 11 to 1. Each family brings one dish to share; please add yours to the sign-up list by Thursday Nov 5. Runners should bring their team shirt to swap for the season medal.

subject: Correction: field trip fee
body: Correction to my earlier message: the field trip fee is $15, not $12, because of a bus price change. If you already paid $12 please send the extra $3 with the permission slip. The slip deadline stays Tuesday Nov 3.
